sources.title: ANEMLL — On-Device AI for Apple Silicon
sources.snippet: Anemll v0.3.5 Beta The flagship library for porting Large Language Models to the Apple Neural Engine (ANE). Convert models directly from HuggingFace to CoreML, optimized for ANE tensor processing. Includes Swift and Python inference, iOS/macOS/visionOS sample apps, and a full conversion pipeline — all targeting low-power, on-device, fully private AI.
